name: Angie, Personal AI Assistant with Telegram Voice and Text
description: Personal voice & text assistant bot that answers queries, manages tasks, and interacts naturally using AI.

source.path: Telegram/Angie, Personal AI Assistant with Telegram Voice and Text.json

setup: "Listen for incoming events" (telegramTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

Workflow secret TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: Telegram bot token (from @BotFather) for api.telegram.org (URL path /bot<secret>/getFile). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.
Provide run inputs: event, sessionId, llm_system_dd4b637516, message.

hints: The original started from telegramTrigger; Yantra has no webhook slug for it, so run on demand, on a schedule (add a NodeCron), or via the workflow API with the event under the run input `event`.
"Get Voice File" (telegram.file.get): Uses the Telegram Bot API getFile HTTP call with the bot token from a workflow secret; download file_path from the JSON result.
"Get Voice File": the file itself is at https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path>; the token is the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN workflow secret.
"Get Voice File": a request field used $('OtherNode'); on Yantra $() resolves via the named upstream map when that node ran earlier, else the immediate upstream - check that expression.
"Speech to Text" transcribes the Telegram voice file by URL (Bot API file path) with the platform Whisper; no OpenAI key needed.
"Angie, AI Assistant 👩🏻‍🏫" kept conversation memory (memoryBufferWindow); sessionId is set to the run-input sessionId.

"Angie, AI Assistant 👩🏻‍🏫" used agent tools in the original: Tasks (baserowTool), Contacts (baserowTool), Get Email (gmailTool), Google Calendar (googleCalendarTool). The cdecli agent calls connectors directly; connect credentials for the services those tools reached. Prefer connectors: baserow, googlesuper.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect baserow: `cdecli credential create -n "baserow" -p baserow --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect googlesuper: `cdecli credential create -n "googlesuper" -p googlesuper --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
